# trovely: API for agents

trovely stores photos and videos for inspiration, groups them into boards, and shows public uploads on Discover.
Base URL: the site you were given (for example https://trovely.example).

## Auth
Ask the user for an API token (made at /#/account). Send it on every write:
  Authorization: Bearer <token>

## Upload files
POST /api/media   (multipart/form-data)
  files        one or more files (repeat the field). JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, AVIF, MP4, WebM, MOV. 100 MB each, 20 per request.
  tags         comma-separated, e.g. "warm, interiors, 70s"
  title        optional
  source_url   optional http(s) link
  visibility   "public" (default, on Discover) or "private"

Example:
  curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -F "files=@photo.jpg" -F "tags=warm,interiors" $SITE/api/media

## Pin to a board
POST /api/pins   JSON {"media_id": "...", "board_id": "..."}   (board_id optional; defaults to "Saved")

## Boards
POST /api/boards          JSON {"name", "description", "category", "visibility": "private"|"public"}
GET  /api/boards?scope=mine
POST /api/boards/:id/items  JSON {"media_id"}
DELETE /api/boards/:id/items/:mediaId

## Read (no token needed for public items)
GET /api/media?tag=warm&q=text&limit=60&offset=0
GET /api/media/:id
GET /api/tags
GET /api/boards?category=interiors

## Edit and delete (owner only)
PATCH /api/media/:id   JSON {"title", "tags": [...], "source_url", "visibility"}
DELETE /api/media/:id
PATCH /api/boards/:id, DELETE /api/boards/:id

Private items never appear in Discover or public boards. Anyone with a direct /media/ link can still open a file, so treat links as unlisted.
